import {h,createSSRApp,shallowRef,nextTick,onMounted,onUnmounted} from '/frameworks/vue.mjs';
export {h};
export const lifecycle={mounted:0,unmounted:0};
let app,state;
export function mount(view,initial,root){state=shallowRef(initial);app=createSSRApp({setup(){onMounted(()=>lifecycle.mounted++);onUnmounted(()=>lifecycle.unmounted++);return()=>view(state.value);}});app.mount(root);}
export function update(value){state.value=value;}
export async function flush(){await nextTick();}
export function unmount(){app.unmount();}
